statute_note: Principal source selected: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML edition (53-1938-bank-of-ceylon-ordinance-consolidated.html, chain header 'Ordinance Nos, 53 of 1938 45 of 1939 53 of 1943 4 of 1944 34 of 1944 7 of 1945 Law Nos, 10 of 1974 Act Nos, 39 of 1949 19 of 1952 42 of 1954 37 of 1955 34 of 1968 60 of 1980 54 of 2000'), parsed into the accepted tree of 59 sections; no section text was changed by hand except the removal of LankaLaw's editorial footnote from 41(3). Other sources inspected: the registry's official Bank of Ceylon PDF (statutes/53-1938-bank-of-ceylon-ordinance.pdf, Chapter 397 layout, 30 pp., text layer, same chain in its header, head date '(1st December, 1938.)'), whose marginal notes sit to the right of the text so parse_consolidated_pdf.py cannot read it; it was used as the verification source for the repealed numbers, the pre-1974 markers and the Schedules. Scans of Acts Nos. 19 of 1952 (4 pp.), 42 of 1954 (2 pp.), 37 of 1955 (2 pp.) and 34 of 1968 (2 pp.), title pages read and OCR sidecars made for the first three; LankaLaw HTML of Law No. 10 of 1974 and Acts Nos. 34 of 1968, 60 of 1980 and 54 of 2000 (no subscription banner). Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 54 of 2000. Review performed: diff of the accepted tree against the regenerated canonical parse (identical); every one of the 22 missing section numbers checked against the PDF's own 'Repealed (§N, 10 of 1974)' stubs (pp.13, 14, 17, 18) and listed individually in omitted_provisions; every held amending title page opened; validate_finalized_trees.py zero errors, zero undocumented warnings. Amendment coverage: 13 known, 7 held. Inline markers in the HTML baseline name only 10 of 1974 (38), 60 of 1980 (2) and 54 of 2000 (9); the official PDF also prints section-level markers for 4 of 1944, 19 of 1952, 37 of 1955 and 34 of 1968, so the older instruments are attributed only by the chain header. The six Ordinances and Acts not held (45 of 1939, 53 of 1943, 4 of 1944, 34 of 1944, 7 of 1945, 39 of 1949) are all pre-1956 and their operations are in the baseline text. Structural weaknesses: 22 section numbers (34-40, 45-55, 66-67, 73, 75) are repealed by Law No. 10 of 1974 and omitted by the HTML rather than printed as stubs; the earlier notes listed 21 of them and missed 75. The section index's 82 rows for this statute are the 59 tree sections plus 23 legacy rows from the earlier PDF extraction: the 22 repealed stubs and a phantom 'section 279' made of body text. The three Schedules (the First is the list of business the bank may transact, s.71) are printed in the PDF on pp.19-30 but not in the HTML and are not transcribed; Acts Nos. 42 of 1954, 37 of 1955 and 34 of 1968 amend only the First Schedule, so their effect is not visible in this tree. Missing sources: Ordinances Nos. 45 of 1939, 53 of 1943, 4 of 1944, 34 of 1944, 7 of 1945 and Act No. 39 of 1949; no Government Printer copy of Law No. 10 of 1974 or Acts Nos. 60 of 1980 and 54 of 2000 (HTML only; the assignment's description of 54 of 2000 as Government Printer text does not match what is on disk). Unresolved questions: data/processed/amendment-chains.csv lists 11 instruments for SRC044 and omits 45 of 1939 and 60 of 1980 although the PDF header names both, and it records 53 of 1943 at position 0 as 'amending' with no principal row; the tree's date_stated_in_source is empty because the HTML prints only '[ December , 1938 ]' while the PDF prints '(1st December, 1938.)'. Lawyer verification: unverified.
